integrity: The claim is mathematically proved for the full stated parameter range using a three-vertex-path decomposition and a Johnson-graph fiber argument. Exhaustive cases provide corroboration only, not an infinite proof. Independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only board dimensions 3k by 3k with k>=1 and simultaneous one/two-vertex replacement are covered. The optimum count and three-path packing correspondence were known earlier. No assertion for other dimensions or general shortest reconfiguration distances.
title: Sharp two-replacement mobility of optimum dissociation sets in square rook graphs
